reconstruction_differences.clock_compile: Probe: zig cc -c -O3 native_clock.c; compiler adds -target x86_64-linux-gnu.2.31 and target.cpu_flags.
reconstruction_differences.object_order: Probe runtime, clock, LLVM unit; compiler runtime, LLVM unit, clock.
reconstruction_differences.link_flags: Probe uses cf.ZIG_FLAGS and always -lm; compiler adds -pthread and links -lm only if needed.
reconstruction_differences.source_identity: Fresh compiler rebuild and M0 used different owned source/cache paths, so metadata and LLVM object names may differ; binary identity is explicitly false, not assumed.
